cases.name: Ann Rackley Waltrip
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Ann lived the greater part of her life in Texas. She grew up in Fort Worth, Texas, and attended Texas Tech University. It was at Texas Tech University that she met her husband, Bill (William) Waltrip. Ann Rackley and Bill Waltrip were married in 1970. Ann and Bill settled in Austin, Texas, where they would raise their two children, Chris and Amy. Ann worked for the State of Texas. However, once her children were born, she chose to focus on her family. Ann loved her children. She always made them feel worthy and encouraged them to be kind to themselves. Ann was a devoted mother. She was creative, magically making every birthday and holiday feel unique and special for her children. Her family remembers how Ann loved to laugh and especially her enjoyment of “bad” sci-fi and horror movies. Ann loved her husband, Bill Waltrip. In August of 2021, they celebrated 51 years of marriage. Ann also had a lifelong love for animals. She volunteered with the Metroport Humane Society taking care of the cats in the adoption centers at Petco."
